protocol.title: Delayed L3 slot gradient-dose intervention

training.rule: read/fusion active from step 1; L3 slot queries frozen through step 300, then gradient-scaled; other L2/L3 Memory groups frozen

protocol.primary_test: whether slot-query interference scales with its post-step300 gradient dose
protocol.stop_rule: no extra doses, delays, arms, thresholds, seeds, or steps

diagnosis.interpretation_scope: Four frozen outcome-stratified endpoints; not a prevalence estimate.
diagnosis.registered_stop_boundary: Report the fixed parameter-group intervention. Do not add groups, layers, seeds, steps, or post-hoc gates.
